We presented the first detection of the rotational emission lines of the amide-like molecule cyanamide () towards the hot molecular core G358.93–0.03 MM1 using the Atacama Large Millimeter/Submillimeter Array (ALMA).

We also discussed the possible formation mechanisms of towards the hot molecular cores and hot corinos, and we find that the molecule was created in the grain-surfaces of G358.93–0.03 MM1 via the neutral-neutral reaction between and CN.
